They assist in the activities of the Board of Executive

Officers, electing and dismissing its members. It meets
ordinarily six times a year, and extraordinarily when the

With clients and business partners,

inputs.input: What was the revenue of Brazil?
context:
Total revenues increased 6.6% to Ps. 23,740 million, driven by our volume growth, revenue management and favorable mix
effects. This increase was partially offset by unfavorable currency translation effects of most of our operating currencies in the
division into Mexican Pesos. On a comparable basis, total revenues would have increased 27.5%.
Gross profit increased 11.0% to Ps. 9,539 million, and gross margin expanded 160 basis points to 40.2%. This increase was
driven mainly by our top-line growth, favorable mix effects, and raw material hedging strategies. This increase was partially
offset by increases in raw material costs such as sweeteners and PET. On a comparable basis, gross profit would have increased
34.8%.
Operating income increased 43.3% to Ps. 2,713 million in the first quarter of 2023, resulting in an operating margin expansion of
290 basis points to 11.4%. This increase was driven mainly by higher gross profit and an increase in operating leverage resulting
from volume growth and operating expense efficiencies. On a comparable basis, operating income would have increased 77.7%.
(1)
Please refer to page 8 for our definition of “comparable” and a description of the factors affecting the comparability of our financial and operating performance.
inputs.actual_output: According to the provided document text, specifically on page 13 of the Coca-Cola-FEMSA-Results-1Q23-vf-2.pdf, the revenue of Brazil for the first quarter of 2023 was Ps. 15,969 million, which includes beer revenues of Ps. 1,450 million. For the same period in the previous year, the revenue was Ps. 14,388 million, including beer revenues of Ps. 1,250 million.
